Name: Summer Hours
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Expands the hours the villagers houses and shops are open during the summer!
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT HERE, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUBOther websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

Ever wished Pierre opened a __teeny__ bit earlier?  Had to wait for a house to unlock to gift your sweetheart?  Now you don't have to wait as long, but only during the summer!

This mod requires [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) and [TMX Loader](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820) (which in turn requires [PyTK](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)) in order to edit both the door locks and the schedules of the NPCs.  I also recommend [Dynamic Nighttime](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2072) to improve your immersion.

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4!

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915),[PytK](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)﻿ and [TMX Loader](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820)﻿.

3.  Download this mod and unzip it.  Choose either the SummerOnly (original) or YearRound version and open the folder.

4.  Copy  the '[CP] Summer Hours' and '[TMX] Summer Hours' folders into Stardew Valley/Mods.

5.  Run the game using SMAPI, you're done!
Known Issues

*   There may be an issue with villager schedules not returning to normal after summer is over.  Pathos is working on a fix for this in SMAPI 3.0, which will release with SDV 1.4.
Update log

*   1.1.1 - Pulled a Spacechase with 1.1.0 and forgot to increment the manifest.  Fixed in this update.

*   1.1.0 - Added optional year round version

*   1.0.2 - Fixed a big goof with Robin's schedule, thanks Trent!

*   1.0.1 - Removed map properties from patch maps

*   1.0.0 - Initial version
Credit to [Lumisteria](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844) for the idea and to [hatmouse](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1949074) for helping me with the TMXL coding!

If you like my mods, please consider checking out my [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/minervamaga)﻿ or [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/U7U69L0R)﻿!
